severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — ARTISANAL INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: COUNTERFEIT-HANDICRAFT FRONT SETTLES OVER THE ETSY HOLLOWS AS AI-GENERATED KNOCKOFF LISTINGS CLONE ORIGINAL MAKERS' WORK OVERNIGHT, UNDERCUTTING THE HANDS THAT ACTUALLY STITCHED IT WITH PRODUCTS THAT WERE NEVER HELD, MEASURED, OR MADE
advisory: The Service is tracking a persistent low-pressure system of synthetic craft listings advancing across marketplace regions. Residents are advised that a handmade item going viral now functions as a weather event: within hours, a bank of AI-generated imitations forms downwind, priced lower and photographed by no camera. Verify that the shop you are buying from has a pulse, a backlog, and a human willing to answer a question about yarn.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy counterfeit-craft accumulation around every trending handmade item, with cloned listings reaching peak density within six hours of a maker's first viral post. Visibility for genuine artisans reduced to near zero.
Unseasonable clearing reported as platform authorities signal they have grown weary of synthetic posts. Residents should remain calm; the thinking-face emoji is forecast to retreat only gradually.
A fabricated wildlife-attack clip continues to circulate on strong engagement currents, outrunning every correction. Travelers reminded that a video is not an affidavit.
Boards saturated with AI 'inspiration' crafts that cannot physically be assembled. Pinning advised; attempting is not.
Scattered clone-utility apps with stock icons and five identical five-star reviews posted in the same minute. Mild and relentless.

specimen.status: Invasive; proliferating wherever a human succeeds
specimen.habitat: Fresh virality zones of handmade marketplaces; nests downwind of any original maker's best-selling listing.
specimen.field_marks: Product photos with impossibly even lighting and no reflection of a workspace; a shop opened days ago with hundreds of 'handmade' items; prices suspiciously below the cost of the materials alone; a listing that cannot answer where the yarn came from.
specimen.call: Handmade with love — ships in 1 business day — ask me nothing about it.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for the real maker it is copying. Tell them apart by shop age, response to questions, and the presence of actual stitching imperfections; the genuine article has a human behind it and occasionally a cat in frame.

spotter_tip: Ask the shop a specific question only a maker could answer — a hook size, a stitch name, how long one takes. The Mimic Maker will reply with a warm paragraph that answers none of it.
tomorrow: Counterfeit-craft front lingers; brief clearing possible over the LinkedIn Plateau before fresh clone cells redevelop by evening.

confirmed_sighting.report: A handmade crochet product that went viral spawned a wave of AI-generated knockoff listings on Etsy, illustrating a growing trend of synthetic copies that undercut the original makers on online marketplaces.
